name: Exposure to wallets attributed to designated, stolen-fund or illicit actors
description: Customer transacts directly or near-directly with blockchain addresses attributed by sanctions lists or analytics to designated persons, thefts, ransomware or terrorist fundraising.
fp: Indirect exposure through large services or mixed-source addresses can generate low-quality hits; assess hop distance and attribution confidence.

links.name: Ransomware-linked wallet exposure
links.ctx: Payments to wallets attributed to ransomware.

links.name: Inflows of stolen virtual assets traced by analytics
links.ctx: Deposits with direct or near-direct exposure to addresses attributed to major thefts.

links.name: Wallet addresses attributed to designated persons
links.ctx: Customer transacts with addresses published in sanctions lists or attributed by analytics.

links.name: Deposits from or withdrawals to wallets attributed to terrorist fundraising
links.ctx: On-chain analytics link counterparty addresses to published designations or documented fundraising campaigns.
